Apartament 2+1 me verande prane Oxhakut!
Apartament ne shitje, 2+1 me verande, prane Oxhakut!
- Apartamenti eshte pjese e nje kompleksi te ri rezidencial, ne nje zone mjafte te zhvilluar te kryeqytetit, buze rruges Xhanfize Keko, prane te gjitha faciliteteve per nje jetese komode.
- Ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 122m2 te organizuar ne sallonin e ndenjes, ambientin e gatimit/ngrenies te vecuar, 2 dhoma gjumi, 1 tualet, 2 korridore qe bejne shperndarjen e ambienteve si dhe veranda me akses nga te gjitha ambientet e apartamentit.
- Apartamenti eshte i investuar se fundmi me instalime dhe rifinitura dhe ofrohet totalisht i mobiluar si ne foto.
- Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: 2+1 apartment with veranda near the fireplace!
description_en: 2+1 apartment with veranda near the fireplace! Apartment for sale, 2+1 with veranda, near the fireplace! - The apartment is part of a new residential complex, in a fairly developed area of ​​the capital, near Xhanfize Keko street, near all facilities for a comfortable life. - It has a total area of ​​122m2 organized in the living room, separate cooking/dining area, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, 2 corridors that distribute the premises as well as verandas with access from all the premises of the apartment. - The apartment is recently invested with installations and refinishing and is offered fully furnished as in the photo. - The property has regular mortgage documentation.
